[SWS_CM_00827] Default value of Minimum Send Interval and disabling Min-
imum Send Interval time monitoring for SetHandlers for Clients
⌈
If the config-
ured Minimum Send Interval (
ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement
.
minimum-
SendInterval
) of a Set() of the respective field class has the value 0, the Minimum
Send Interval monitoring shall not be active for the corresponding
Field::Set()
,
i.e.,
ara::com
will not limit the Tx frequency by dropping
Field::Set()
calls by
